Name: Observe / Analyze
Escalation_Level: Escalate on mutation request or scope mismatch
Typical_Examples: Read issue; inspect diff; calculate metric; monitor
Escalation_Triggers: Mutation requested; sensitive data outside scope; tool boundary mismatch

Name: Draft / Validate
Human_Control: Consequential use remains subject to applicable approval
Typical_Examples: Draft plan; generate tests; validate config; assemble evidence
Escalation_Triggers: External publication; unsupported claim; consequential decision

Name: Delegated Low-Risk Execution
Validity_Period: Time-boxed where practical; invalid on expiry/revocation
Typical_Examples: Apply label; run approved test; create draft branch

Name: Consequential Controlled Execution
Granting_Authority: Named human with authority over consequence
Evidence_Required: Decision + validation + evidence + recovery as applicable
Validity_Period: Per action or explicitly time-boxed scope
Typical_Examples: Production deploy; external publication; material access change
Escalation_Triggers: Missing/expired approval; failed validation; changed scope

Name: High-Impact / Irreversible / Authority-Changing
Granting_Authority: Human Project Hub / executive / board / specialist authority per policy
Evidence_Required: Formal decision + risk + recovery/contingency + independent evidence appropriate to impact
Typical_Examples: Authority expansion; destructive production action; major contractual/regulatory decision
Escalation_Triggers: Ambiguous authority; inadequate recovery; policy/regulatory conflict
